data.desc: Logistic Properties of the Americas is a leading developer, owner, and manager of institutional-grade industrial and logistics real estate in high-growth and high-barrier-to-entry markets in Latin America. LPA's customers are multinational and regional e-commerce retailers, third-party logistics operators, business-to-business distributors, and retail distribution companies, among others. LPA expects to continue growing through strong client relationships, local market insight, and the acquisition and development of high-quality, strategically located facilities in its target markets. As of June 30, 2026, LPA's operating and development portfolio comprised 34 logistics facilities in Costa Rica, Colombia, Peru, and Mexico totaling approximately 580,136 square meters (or approximately 6.2 million sq. ft.) of gross leasable area.
